🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 25, 2026

Venus, at home in Libra, holds a trine to the North Node, on the karmic axis in Aquarius. Two air signs looking at each other: what you already own finally finds the words to be counted.

Easier — Agreeing on a figure without feeling robbed by it.
Harder — Agreeing to something because agreeing feels pleasant.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Venus in Libra stands opposite, and what you value is quoted back. Cardinal fire starts and is invoiced for it. It has stood four weeks; by now the cost is known.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you, at home in Libra. Mercury in Scorpio mirrors you, and the mirror keeps its own figures. Fixed earth: the grip costs more than the thing. Unchanged for four weeks: you know what it asks.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, is only passing through Scorpio. From Libra, Venus concedes the point early. Air bends, and bending costs nothing here. A week ago Mercury was still held by Moon; that is finished.

♋ CANCER
Moon governs you from Gemini on plain terms, without privilege. Venus squares you from Libra, and the cost objects. Cardinal water: the beginning has a price on it. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you, untitled in Sagittarius. From Libra, Venus hands you an opening. Fire that holds on, holding without strain. Sun left Scorpio four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. From Sagittarius, Sun sets a figure against the wanting. Mutable earth: keeping options is the expense. Mercury went direct two weeks ago; the re-reading is over.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is at home in Libra. Sun sextiles you from Sagittarius: a door left ajar. Cardinal air: beginning costs almost nothing. The conjunction to Sun that held four weeks ago has let go.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars governs you, untitled in Leo. Mercury is in your sign now, handling what you own at close range. Water holds on until the thing and the self are one. The square of four weeks ago is off it now.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. Venus in Libra makes room for you, and then waits. Mutable fire keeps two accounts, and both balance. Four weeks of it, long enough to have stopped noticing.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. From Libra, Venus cuts across you: the sum arrives before the appetite. Earth that starts things, billed for starting. Four weeks of this, and none of it is news.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you from Aries, where it stands lowest. Venus in Libra trines you: agreement arrives before the argument. Air keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. Moon let go of it two weeks ago.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. From Sagittarius, Sun cuts across the appetite. Water that changes shape, charged for each shape. The hold Mercury had four weeks ago is not there any more.
